context: A phone call. Tatsuya is calling Dr. Saito's rural rotation hotline. His wife has been worse this week than last.
purpose: rural patient + city doctor over phone — slow grave concern

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: もしもし、先生。…遅くにすまんな。
lines.en: Hello, Doctor. …Sorry to call so late.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Tohoku cadence underneath. Tired but not rushed—each word placed with care. Slight apologetic catch on the apology.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いえいえ、大丈夫です。どうされましたか。
lines.en: No, it's fine. What's going on?
lines.style: Calm professional anchor. Voice drops half a step warmer on the reassurance. Immediate shift into listening mode—attentive, no performative sympathy.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 妻が、今日、ちょっと、しんどそうで。
lines.en: My wife—today she seems to be in some pain.
lines.style: Careful, measured report. Each phrase separated by small breath. The word 'pain' carries visible weight. Quiet worry underneath, not dramatized.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: どんな感じですか、具体的に。
lines.style: Precise, small question. Professional focus clicking on. Pen ready in the voice. Not brusque, but efficiently gathered toward information.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 熱は出てない。けど、息が、本当に苦しそうで。
lines.en: No fever. But her breathing—it looks really difficult.
lines.style: Steady, factual report. Voice tightens slightly underneath on 'breathing'—the real concern surfaces. Slow pace. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 心配ですね。明日の朝、私が、伺います。
lines.en: That is concerning. I'll come by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Small firm decision. Voice carries the full weight of professional authority—not rushed, but definitive. Grounded compassion underneath.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Small surprised gratitude breaking through. Half-protest, half-acceptance. Voice rises slightly on the question, then trails off in deference.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: これが仕事です。今夜、何かあったら、すぐ電話。
lines.en: This is my job. If anything happens tonight, call right away.
lines.style: Grounded, practical instruction. Voice steady and genuine—no reassurance-performance, just honest competence. Almost brisk, but genuinely warm underneath.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 本当に、ありがとうございます、先生。
lines.style: Real Tohoku formality—deep gratitude, not habitual politeness. Voice catches slightly on the thanks. Quiet sincerity. Small bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: おやすみなさい。少しでも、休んで。
lines.en: Good night. Get some rest, even a little.
lines.style: Small kind closer—doctor-as-person speaking. Steady, attentive presence. Not rushed, not lingering. Genuine concern held lightly in the voice.
